rationale.overall: Aside from the paper curl the takes are nearly the same, and B’s curl carries the translucent volumetric ribbon the REFERENCE depends on while A’s washes into the ground.
rationale.material: B’s curl shows edge thickness, inner-face falloff, and a brighter top highlight matching the REFERENCE’s translucent volume, whereas A’s reads as a low-contrast haze.
rationale.silhouette: The dark block matches in both, but B’s curl still closes as a readable loop against the texture while A’s dissolves and softens the overall shape.
rationale.smallsize: At 128/32/16 the curl drops out in both takes and the dark diagonal block plus orange edge read the same, so neither gains an advantage.
